morphology.formula: ∅ + Lenore → Lenore（外语专名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 不能按马来语词缀拆分。作为姓名应大写为 Lenore；所列 IPA 是英语非卷舌读法，并非已确认的马来语标准读音，具体以姓名使用者的读法为准。

senses.zh_definition: Lenore，英语女性名字，通常视为 Eleanor 的短形式；在马来语文本中属于外语专名。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name, commonly a short form of Eleanor, used as a proper name in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya bentuk pendek bagi Eleanor; bukan kata nama am bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 输入只有小写词形，无法确定具体指哪一位人物或哪一部作品；此处按常见姓名解释，不虚构马来语普通词义。以下为自然的姓名用法，不声称是经语料统计确认的高频固定搭配。[Lenore 的姓名资料与读音](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lenore)。

etymology.historical_story: Lenore belongs to the European Eleanor name family rather than to Malay derivational morphology. Edgar Allan Poe gave the name a lasting literary association through his poem Lenore and the lost beloved in The Raven. That literary connection does not establish a literal name meaning such as light. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lenore), [Poe scholarship](https://www.eapoe.org/WorkS/mabbott/tom1p078.htm).
